name: open-merch-studio
description: Open-source custom merch studio for uploads, assisted artwork, previews, checkout, and curated fulfillment.

scripts.dev: concurrently "node \"$npm_execpath\" --workspace open-merch-studio-backend run dev" "node \"$npm_execpath\" --workspace open-merch-studio-frontend run dev"
scripts.build: node "$npm_execpath" --workspace open-merch-studio-backend run build && node "$npm_execpath" --workspace open-merch-studio-frontend run build
scripts.lint: node "$npm_execpath" --workspace open-merch-studio-backend run lint && node "$npm_execpath" --workspace open-merch-studio-frontend run lint
scripts.type-check: node "$npm_execpath" --workspace open-merch-studio-backend run type-check && node "$npm_execpath" --workspace open-merch-studio-frontend run type-check
scripts.test: node "$npm_execpath" --workspace open-merch-studio-backend run test && node --import tsx frontend/scripts/local-fixture-contract.mts
